title: Why are 'ungrateful' and 'denying God' the same word in the Qur'an?

beats.narration: In the Qur'an, being ungrateful and denying God are the very same word. Why would those be one word?

This verse makes a promise: be grateful, and you'll be given more. But the word it uses for the opposite of grateful is the same one it uses for denying God — one root, *kufr*, meaning to cover something over.
Here's where it gets interesting: the Qur'an places the two side by side — 'be grateful to Me, and do not cover Me over.' The same word that means denying God is the word for shrugging off a gift.

verse.highlight_phrase_en: do not be ungrateful toward Me

beats.narration: So ingratitude isn't treated as a small thing. Covering over a gift is the same motion as covering over the one who gave it — and a gift you've hidden from yourself is one you can no longer enjoy.
